name: Anna Larkin
title: Senior Analyst @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Anna is a Senior Analyst on the Data Science & Strategy Team at Birch Hill Equity Partners. Anna received her HBA from the Richard Ivey School of Business and her Bachelor of Engineering Science in Software Engineering from Western University. Prior to joining Birch Hill in 2022, Anna was a summer analyst in Birch Hill's Data Science team, and prior to that, a technology analyst intern at Whitehorse Liquidity Partners and before that an IT systems developer intern at the Bank of Canada.

name: Rachael Walker
title: Senior Analyst @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Rachael is a Senior Analyst on the Data Science & Strategy Team at Birch Hill Equity Partners. Rachael graduated from the University of Toronto with a Bachelor of Applied Science in Industrial Engineering with a minor in Artificial Intelligence. Prior to joining Birch Hill in 2023, Rachael was a data analyst, strategy and analytics at Kijiji and before that, a data analyst at HomeEquity Bank for two summers.

name: Olivia Tracey
title: Senior Analyst @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Olivia is a Senior Analyst on the Data Science & Strategy Team at Birch Hill Equity Partners. Olivia received her Bachelor of Applied Science with a major in Engineering Science, and minors in Artificial Intelligence and Business from the University of Toronto. Prior to joining Birch Hill in 2023, Olivia was an analyst in Birch Hill’s Data Science group for her Professional Experience Year as part of the Co-op Program at the University of Toronto.

name: Kelly Chang
title: Analyst @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Kelly is an Analyst on the Data Science & Strategy Team at Birch Hill Equity Partners. Kelly received her Bachelor of Applied Science from the University of Toronto, with a major in Industrial Engineering and a minor in Artificial Intelligence. Prior to joining Birch Hill in 2025, Kelly was a co-op analyst in Birch Hill’s Data Science team.

name: Lilia Kautz
title: PEY Co-op @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Lilia joined Birch Hill in May 2025 for her Professional Experience Year as part of the Co-op Program at the University of Toronto. She previously interned with the Global Supply Chain team at Grainger Canada. Lilia looks forward to graduating in 2027 from the University of Toronto with a BASc in Industrial Engineering.

name: Sarvnaz Ale Mohammad
title: PEY Co-op @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Sarvnaz joined Birch Hill in May 2025 for her Professional Experience Year as part of the Co-op Program at the University of Toronto. She previously interned at McKinsey & Company, and as a student researcher at Mount Sinai Hospital. Sarvnaz looks forward to graduating in 2027 from the University of Toronto with a BASc in Engineering Science, specializing in Machine Intelligence.
